Attaching a short bundle of assets and a first pass ask list for the AWS listing page. Goal is to finalize the hero blurb, the trial CTA wording, and two concrete entitlement examples the field can use in outreach by EOD Friday. Key constraints from procurement: must be clear about trial limits and billing trigger.

Quick asks:
- Kimberley: pick the final hero one-liner from the three variants in hero_options_v3.png and flag any compliance/legal notes.
- Marissa: draft 2–3 one-paragraph 'usage example' snippets that map to SKU entitlements (POC, pilot, production). Put examples in sku_entitlements_v1.xlsx.
- Jonas: confirm trial CTA flows in trial_flow_spec.md match the private offer footprint (private offers + paid conversion flow).
- Sara: FYI — want your buy-in on the trial limits wording so procurement can approve the private offer template.

Attachments: hero_options_v3.png, trial_flow_spec.md, sku_entitlements_v1.xlsx

Thanks — brief sync at 3pm PT if useful.

—Laura

- Entitlement examples: make sure each example explicitly ties to SKU name and billing trigger. I'll add small copy edits in sku_entitlements_v1.xlsx.

I can join 3pm PT sync if helpful.

Adding the field playbook examples — pasted below and saved in sku_entitlements_v1.xlsx under the "Field Snippets" tab. Also attached a quick pricing parity note for procurement.

Usage example A (POC):
"ACME used Redwood Inference to prototype a customer support summarization feature during a two-week POC. The POC used the POC-sku (up to 50k tokens) and showcased 40% faster response times vs their previous infra. After POC, ACME converted to a pilot bundle."

Usage example B (Pilot -> Production):
"During a 30-day pilot (Pilot-sku, up to 300k tokens), ACME validated throughput and moved to a reserved capacity plan for production. Billing begins when pilot metrics are satisfied and the private offer is accepted."

Practical notes for field:
- Use the POC example when customer asks for risk-limited evaluation.
- Use the Pilot example for procurement conversations — it explains the billing trigger clearly.
- If a customer needs longer trials, route to sales ops for a private offer amendment.

I also attached sku_entitlements_v1.xlsx with the SKU-to-example mapping. Jonas — can you confirm the SKU names match what you'll publish in the console?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole

Thank you all — quick consolidation and next steps: 
- Hero: Kimberly to lock Variant B + remove "unlimited" language (deadline: Thu 9/10 11am PT).
- Trial CTA: final copy = "Start a 30-day trial (up to 100k tokens)." Kimberly will add the footnote copy and send the final line to Sara for procurement OK.
- Field snippets: Marissa's examples look good; Marissa to push the final tab to the shared Drive (already saved) and add a short two-sentence sales script for each.
- SKU sync: Jonas to confirm SKU identifiers for console publish and share the exact labels we will use in the listing (due Thu 9/10 EOD).
- Ops: I will open the private offer ticket with AWS Marketplace Ops and attach sku_entitlements_v1.xlsx + trial_flow_spec.md.

Sara — could you confirm procurement is OK with the proposed trial limits and the "billing begins after conversion/acceptance of private offer" phrasing? A short reply here is fine.

If there's no major redlines, we'll submit the listing draft to AWS by Monday morning to hit the customer's internal launch window.

Thanks —
Laura
